question: What preparatory rites and quantity govern recitation of the vidyā?
premises: Recitation should reach one hundred thousand times.
Fire offering and libation must precede recitation.
inference: Proper recitation of the vidyā requires one hundred thousand repetitions preceded by homa and tarpaṇa.
plain_english: One should recite the vidyā one hundred thousand times, preceded by fire offering and libation.
